name: Beginner bodyweight
notes: No equipment. Three short full-body days aimed at beginners. Kneeling push-ups and shorter holds are fine. Rest at least a day between sessions when you can.

activities.name: Bodyweight strength
activities.instructions: Move slowly. Rest about 90 seconds between sets. Stop with 1–2 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.instructions: Feet about shoulder width. Sit the hips back and down, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands under the shoulders. Lower the chest, then press up. Use knees if you need to.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips.

exercises.name: Front plank
exercises.instructions: Ribs down, glutes on. Hold a straight line from head to heels.

activities.name: Weekend bodyweight
activities.instructions: Weekend session. Keep the effort moderate and the form tidy.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.instructions: Step one foot back, lower the back knee, then stand. Alternate sides each rep, or finish one side then the other.
exercises.notes: Count total lunges across both legs.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands under the shoulders. Lower the chest, then press up. Use knees if you need to.

exercises.name: Standing hip hinge
exercises.instructions: Soft knees, push the hips back, keep a long spine, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: On your back, ribs down. Reach one arm and the opposite leg away, then switch.

activities.name: Weekend bodyweight
activities.instructions: Second weekend session. Same movements, steady pace.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.instructions: Feet about shoulder width. Sit the hips back and down, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands on a bench, sofa, or wall. Lower the chest, then press up.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: Hold 20 seconds on the left, then swap to the right for set 2. Knees down is fine.
